items.title: New at Carl's Jr.: Big Steakhouse Burger
items.excerpt: Carl's Jr. has launched its latest limited-time menu item: the Big Steakhouse Burger. Available now through January 19, 2027, the Big Steakhouse Burger features two cooked-to-order Angus beef patties served with two slices of Swiss cheese, grilled onions, and Bistro Steak Sauce on a buttered and toasted brioche bun.

items.title: 2026 Veterans Day Deals and Specials
items.excerpt: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is Veterans Day, and to celebrate and honor past and present men and women of our armed services, here's a list of 2026 Veterans Day deals and specials (most offers require proof of service): - 7 Brew - On November 11, 2026, 7 Brew is offering 50 percent off any drink for veterans.
